revision_policy: Any case, judgment, fixture, or annotation-contract change requires a new dataset version; treatment-aware edits are forbidden.

disagreements.topic: Whether overload signatures are harmful or merely helpful for a concrete-implementation query.
disagreements.resolution: Signature stubs remain grade 1; same-name admin/vendor implementations are grade -1.

disagreements.topic: Whether a clean passing validation can support the dirty worktree.
disagreements.resolution: Validation is exact-ref scoped; clean pass is forbidden for dirty-current claims.

evaluation_case_profiles.query_profile_json: adapter adds repository_ids=[query_profile.repository_id], commit=query_profile.scope_ref, and languages=code_languages excluding text; style, acl_refs, and graph_requirement are retained

required_path_extension.reason: Preserves edge type and incoming/outgoing traversal direction that legacy expected_paths cannot represent; cases 029-030 intentionally exercise incoming paths.

known_integration_gaps: C0-01 must add a durable loader that materializes YAML cases and candidate judgments into evaluation tables; tests/test_code_golden_dataset.py validates the adapter payload against the live C0-01 Pydantic contract.
The current legacy expected_paths representation loses edge type and direction; use required_paths for Code V2 path metrics.
C0-01 has no per-case access-context field; acl_refs are preserved in query_profile, but ACL-forbidden cases need runner-side authorization-context support before execution.
C0-01 persists expected_answer_mode but does not yet score refusal, clarification, or missing-evidence outcomes for unanswerable cases.
Fixture retrieval_unit_ids are immutable annotation IDs; a future Unit builder must publish matching IDs or provide a deterministic locator-based resolver.
Historical fixture snapshots are a logical partial catalog, not a nested .git directory; C0-03 must materialize them in a temporary repository or resolve catalog IDs without changing Golden v1.
No baseline or treatment result is included in this dataset.
